Synopsis:
    The UK summoned Russia's chargé d'affaires to formally condemn an alleged Russian drone attack on Leipzig/Halle airport. Germany attributed responsibility to Russia; Russia denied the allegations. The UK framed the incident as part of a broader pattern of Russian destabilisation efforts targeting Western resolve in support of Ukraine.
